title: mut.naive_anti_polish
mutation_directive: Reject smoothness — embrace deliberate imperfection per the 2025-2026 'naïve painting' / 'anti-polish' counter-trend. Add hand-drawn-feeling irregularities: 8-12% per-particle position jitter, slight asymmetry where the piece was symmetric, off-grid placement, visible 'mark-making' (some particles much larger or denser than the field, like brushstrokes). The piece should look like a human's hand on top of code, not a polished AI-generated render.
